8. Complete conditional economics and competent comparisons

All following prices are engineering allowances in 2026 USD, not matched supplier quotations. Repeat manufacture is evaluated at quantity 100, with a 20-year financial horizon and 8% real discount rate. Component lives are finite planning inputs.

Item	Conditional allowance
Repeat module	$186,681
Complete installed equipment	$308,181
First engineering build	$465,580
Initial finite working stocks	$37,640
500-cycle operational expense	$24,783
500-cycle experimental expense, including independent observation	$44,856

Initial stocks and consumed-stock expense are separate accounting views; they should not be added twice.

The installed ledger includes the reference rack, gantry, exchange tools, preload-relief tooling, guarding, two permanent interface families, commissioning and transport. Finite replacements include the drives, cuts, keepers, end joints, optics, force cells, electronics, batteries, frame work and circulating joint bodies. No component receives a 20-year life from the finance horizon.

Strong comparison cases

The assisted case receives the same interfaces, known worksite, load source, good fixtures, hoist, metrology and rescue tools.

The automatic case receives appropriate shoring, a manipulator or gantry, tool changing or zero-point fixtures, engagement/force/pose evidence and independent recovery. ATI’s QC-110 already supplies fail-safe locking and automated exchange features in a compact commercial package. Its individual catalogue limits are not treated as simultaneous qualification for this structural task. 
ATI Industrial Automation

Maskur, Kiyokawa and Harada’s work demonstrates real passive alignment and automatic tool exchange, including one failure among the rotated trials. It is credited as an actual construction, without promoting it into loaded structural exchange or persistent-jam recovery. 
arxiv.org

The complete conditional costs are:

Annual exchanges	Candidate	Strong assisted case	Automatic case
500	$164.09	$70.65	$93.28
2,000	$70.16	$49.16	$51.83
5,000	$54.41	$45.70	$45.10
10,000	$51.31	$44.79	$43.45

These are matched engineering scenarios, not established vendor rankings. The 10,000/year case exceeds one 2,000-hour shift at the modeled duration.
